title: Foundation Pack 001 — Bank, River Bank, Go and Sit — Grammar Analysis Edition
description: A multilingual beginner pack demonstrating polysemy, phrase expansion, vocabulary-to-sentence mapping, and scaffolded sentence building.
notes: Function words such as articles, pronouns and prepositions are stored as grammar tokens but are not required in sentence concept mapping.
